attempted_fix: Checked the spelling of the variable
solution: Define the variable before using it, or move the assignment out of the if-block
explanation: Python only creates a variable when the assignment runs.

solution: Use data.get('id') or check 'id' in data first
explanation: Indexing a missing key raises KeyError; get() returns None instead.

solution: Run pip install requests in the same environment you run the script with
explanation: The package was installed for a different Python than the one running the script.

solution: Use 4 spaces everywhere and convert tabs to spaces
explanation: Mixed tabs and spaces confuse Python's block detection.

error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')
attempted_fix: Added console.log before the map call
explanation: The data had not loaded yet, so items was undefined on first render.

solution: Run npm install express in the project folder
explanation: The dependency was missing from node_modules.

solution: Make sure exactly one source file defines int main() and that it is part of the build
explanation: The linker found no entry point.

error: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "String.length()" because "name" is null
solution: Check name != null before calling length(), or initialise it with an empty string
explanation: A method was called on a reference that was never assigned.
